keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «비가 와서 밖에서 놀 수 없다(문제)» 와 «비 오는 날도 재미있을 수 있다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (it is raining, so Lily cannot play outside) and the lesson (rainy days can be fun too). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: It is raining, so Lily cannot play outside.
They make a tent inside and have fun.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: It is raining, so Lily cannot play
with blankets and chairs. They read
with a flashlight and tell funny
. Lily learns that rainy days can be fun too.

opts: She cannot play outside because of the rain.
Sam does not want to play with her.
evs: It is raining, and Lily cannot play outside.
They make a tent with blankets and chairs.
They eat snacks and tell funny stories.
Then her brother Sam has an idea.
why: 비가 와서 밖에서 놀 수 없기 때문이에요.
It is raining, so she cannot play outside.

qs.q: "Sam has an idea." What does "idea" mean here?
qs.qko: «Sam has an idea» 에서 «idea» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: a new plan to do something
evs: Then her brother Sam has an idea.
It is raining, and Lily cannot play outside.
They eat snacks and tell funny stories.
Lily says, "Rainy days can be fun too!"
why: «idea» 는 «좋은 생각, 새 계획» 이에요. 그 뒤에 샘과 릴리는 텐트를 만들어요.
"Idea" means a new plan. After this, they make a tent.

qs.q: How does the rainy day become fun?
opts: They play inside in a tent.
The rain stops, and they go out.
evs: They make a tent with blankets and chairs.
They read books in the tent with a flashlight.
It is raining, and Lily cannot play outside.
She feels sad and looks out the window.
why: 둘은 텐트를 만들고, 그 안에서 책을 읽어요. 집 안에서 놀아서 재미있어졌어요.
They make a tent and read books in it. Playing inside makes the day fun.

ends: The sun comes out, and Lily and Sam jump in puddles.
해가 나오고, 릴리와 샘이 물웅덩이에서 첨벙첨벙 논다.
Lily shows the tent to her friends.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)

img.cover: Lily, a girl with short black hair and a yellow sweater, and her older brother Sam, a boy with brown hair and a green shirt, sit inside a tent made of blankets over two chairs, reading a book with a flashlight, rain on the window behind them.

scenes.1: In the living room, Sam, a boy with brown hair and a green shirt, holds up a big blanket with a happy face, and Lily, a girl with short black hair and a yellow sweater, stands next to two chairs and watches.
scenes.2: Lily, a girl with short black hair and a yellow sweater, and Sam, a boy with brown hair and a green shirt, sit in the blanket tent eating cookies and laughing, a flashlight lying on a pillow.
